ModMetaData.name: Pawn Editor Forked - In-Game Tests (local only)
ModMetaData.author: SegasWolf
ModMetaData.description:
Local test harness for Pawn Editor Forked. NOT for publishing.
Does nothing at all unless RimWorld is launched with the -pawneditortests argument. Meant to be run through run-ingame-tests.ps1, which starts the game in an isolated data folder, runs every test against real pawns, writes the results to a file and closes the game.
